summary: Meta announced Muse Spark 1.1, an upgrade to Muse Spark 1 with improved agentic, coding, multimodal and computer-use capabilities, alongside a public preview of the Meta Model API.

practices.reason: The post claims broad capability gains over the prior version but gives no benchmark or figure, so the improvement is credible but unverified for our use.
practices.quote: an upgrade to muse spark 1 that greatly improves agentic, coding, multimodal, and computer use capabilities

practices.reason: A new public-preview API surface would need to be evaluated and integrated if we want to build against it.
practices.quote: We're also launching the Meta Model API in public preview.
